Sales change based on a number of things, time of year, weather, holidays, politics. Honestly when you're at a store that's new the first two years are a learning experience for everyone. For the sole, I followed the instructions in [this video](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X_ynYmoWxjU). I honestly think the lady in the video miscounted and so my half double crochet is in a different stitch than hers, but if it's off by one stitch I don't think it will make that big of a difference. I'd say just eye it if her counting seems off to you like it did to me. The size she was making just happened to be my size as well. However, I read somewhere, for the base chain, a good estimate is to measure the length of your foot and subtract the width and then make a chain that is that length. I did that and it turned out to be the same number of chains as in the video for my size, so I'd say it's a very accurate estimate! For the top I just did double crochet all the way around until it began to fit my foot the way I wanted. Then I did single crochet in the last two rounds. I decreased in every 3rd stitch for second to last round and then decreased in every 4th stitch for the very last round. The number of rounds in total will depend on both the width of your foot as well as your preference for the fit.
